text:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 - APIGW spike detected in eu-west-1. Elevated 502/504s from L7 proxy. Oncall: @alice @ben. Runbook: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/apigw-5xx

alice: picking this up, i'm oncall for infra. joining metrics now.

ben: running quick checks — qps jumped from ~3k -> ~28k in ~90s, error rate ~18% on edge.

carla: customer-impact check: multiple major customers in EU seeing timeouts + retries. CS alerted and prepping status update.

alice: looking at proxy pods and mux. `kubectl -n apigw get pods -l cluster=eu-west` lots of 502 logs on proxy.

ben: commands i'm running:
```
curl -s -D - https://apigw-eu-west1.internal/health | head -n 20
kubectl -n apigw logs -l app=apigw-proxy --tail 200 | egrep "502|timeout|reset"
```

dave: seeing connection pool exhaustion on upstream inference pool: backend responses include `read tcp ...: connection reset by peer` and `context deadline exceeded`. Upstream keepalive metrics dropped.

alice: ok — per runbook, step 3: reduce fanout and enable fallback route to lighter model. applying mux change now.

alice: applying: `redwood-muxctl set-route --region eu-west-1 --route default --max-fanout 4 --fallback-model gpt-small-v1`

ben: also enabling edge-level QPS throttles for non-subscriber routes to relieve burst: `edgectl rate-limit set --scope global --qps 2000`

carla: posting incident note to #customer-status and triage email. CCing account teams for high-touch customers.

eve: fallback applied, ~30% of fanout directed to gpt-small-v1. initial effect: error rate dropped from 18% -> ~9% in ~60s. :thumbsup:

alice: recycling suspect backend pods to recover connection pools: `kubectl -n inference delete pod inference-backend-2a3b` then monitor.

dave: rolling restart of backend pool in progress, seeing TLS renegotiation storm on restart. throttling restarts to 1 pod / 20s to avoid surge.

ben: enabled proxy keepalive tuning (increase idle conn reuse), patch pushed to apigw-proxy config.

alice: telemetry update: 502/504s trending down to ~2-3%, p95 latency normalizing. keeping fallback for 10 more minutes then evaluate rolling back.

carla: support update sent: "Degraded responses between 11:02-11:18 UTC, mitigation applied, some customers may have seen errors/latency. Follow-up PM scheduled."

ben: leaving monitoring alerts on high-sensitivity for 30m. If errors stay <5% we move to post-incident.

alice: agreed. next steps: write timeline, config diffs, and add kernel/keepalive tuning to postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared to standby. Please add timeline + RCA notes in #postmortems and tag the oncall rotation.

carla: adding initial timeline to #postmortems now. thanks team. :heart:
